I couldn't set up the recurring 17:30 post, so nothing is scheduled. I posted a reply in #strategic-pod telling you that (ts 1791986400.000127).

Cron jobs I create here run in a local session and their output isn't delivered back to Slack, so I have no way to post into the channel on weekdays. I can post the day's digest in #strategic-pod whenever you ask. A scheduled version would need someone with access to the Slack integration to set it up.
